task.title: Migrating Haystack 3 items
task.shortdesc: For stations originally tagged using Haystack 3, a migration action generates the equivalent Haystack 4 items, tags, tagGroups, and relations, using the N5 JSON‑based configuration model.

li.p: You have an open station connection (local or remote).
The Haystack 4 tag dictionary is installed.
The station's Haystack migration configuration is available in JSON format.

step.cmd: In the station Nav tree, locate TagDictionaryService.
To invoke the migration action, under TagDictionaryService, right-click Haystack4 and select ActionsMigrate Haystack3 Items.
step.stepresult:
The Migrate Haystack3 Items window opens. The migration action uses a JSON configuration file that maps Haystack 3 definitions to their Haystack 4 equivalents.
You can view or modify this JSON file if custom mapping is required.

step.cmd: Click OK to execute the migration action.

taskbody.result: The migration action kicks off a job that logs the actions taken on each component in the station. Any errors are also logged. Once you take action to correct these errors, they can re-run the job as required until the migration is complete.
